blind.description: An ornate wooden enchanting table with carved claw feet and a dark slate or marble tabletop. Draped across one end is a burgundy cloth runner with gold borders, supporting a closed spellbook. In the center sits a round golden dish cradling a faceted purple gemstone. Also on the table are a light wooden wand, a brass candlestick with a candle, and two small polished beads/orbs in green and yellow. Surfaces are clean, continuous, and stylized with hand-painted textures.
blind.from_above: A rectangular dark grey slab top; at the bottom end is a red and gold runner with an angled closed book resting on it; in the center is a round gold bowl holding a purple crystal; above it rests a diagonal wooden wand with a brass candlestick to its left and two small colored spheres (green and yellow) to its right.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 40-45% of the figure's height (roughly 2.3 to 2.5 ft tall) and about half the figure's height in width and length.
